blocks.text: Randy Santiago revealed he had undergone another surgery due to cataract on his right eye, just over a year after he underwent the same procedure for his left eye. The actor-TV host documented his medical journey through his Instagram page on Tuesday, Sept. 22, showing himself at the hospital with medical staff. “After a year from my first cataract surgery on my left eye, I had my right eye done this time,” he said in the caption.
